title: How Noise Cancelling Headphones Work in 60 Seconds 🎧🤫 #shorts
description:
Noise cancelling headphones fight sound with sound. Small microphones on the ear cups listen to the noise around you, a chip creates the exact opposite wave, and the speaker plays it so the two waves cancel out. It works best on steady low sounds like engine hum. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#noisecancelling #headphones #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Noise cancelling headphones fight sound with *more sound*.

steps.label: Listen
steps.text: Tiny *microphones* on each ear cup keep listening to the *noise* around you.

steps.label: Chip
steps.text: A *chip* reads that noise wave *thousands* of times every second.

steps.label: Flip
steps.text: It builds the exact *opposite* wave, flipped *upside down*.

steps.label: Cancel
steps.text: The speaker plays it. Peak meets trough, and the two waves *cancel out*.

steps.label: Best at
steps.text: It works best on steady, *low* sounds like engine *hum*. The soft cushions block the rest.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Listen, flip, *silence*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
